remarks: Charming 1-Bedroom Townhouse in the Heart of SONO!  Located just steps away from the vibrant South Norwalk (SONO) nightlife, this delightful 1-bedroom townhouse offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and urban living. Step inside to discover a spacious, well-lit living area with an open layout that flows seamlessly into the eat-in kitchen, perfect for preparing meals before heading out to explore the local dining, bars, and entertainment options right down the hill.   Enjoy the peacefulness of a private townhouse while being minutes away from all that SONO has to offer-whether you're enjoying a night out or a casual stroll along the waterfront. With its prime location, this townhouse is ideal for anyone who wants to experience the best of both worlds: a quiet retreat and easy access to the buzzing energy of one of Norwalk's most sought-after neighborhoods.  Popular nearby destinations include:  Washington Street (main strip of award winning bars and restaurants): .5 miles The SONO Collection: .7 miles Vets Park and Marina: .9 miles Calf Pasture Beach: 2.5 miles   Don't miss the opportunity to live in the heart of it all-schedule your tour today!
